messages:
Sam W.: PR #3426 is ready — migration guide for Redwood Private (on‑prem) v0.9 -> v1.0. Looking for: eng review (API accuracy), docs style/terminology pass, and SDK example verification. Preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood/pr-3426
Anya P.: I'll take the engineering review. Will validate the SDK snippets and run the example commands locally.
Kevin L.: I can do the style/terminology pass tomorrow morning. Quick Q: do we standardize on 'Redwood Private' vs 'Private deployment' inside migration guides? want to avoid mixed usage.
Sam W.: Good Q — style guide notes: product names capitalized (Redwood API, Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Private). Use 'Private deployment' only for general concept paragraphs. Use active voice and second person for quickstarts. I'll drop a short checklist below.
Sam W.: STYLE CHECKLIST:
- Product names: capitalized (Redwood API / Redwood Dedicated / Redwood Private)
- Prefer 'inference' or 'inference serving' over 'model serving'
- Use active voice; in quickstarts prefer 'we' or 'you' (second person) for steps
- Example placeholders: <project-id>, not PROJECT_ID or all caps
- Keep SDK quickstart snippets <= 8 lines; link to full examples for long cases
- API surface names: use 'endpoint' not 'route' when referring to REST endpoints
Kevin L.: Thanks — I'll do a terminology sweep. Also one python snippet currently uses an old import style. Should be: `from redwood import Client` not `from redwood.client import RedwoodClient`.
Anya P.: CI preview posted an issue, docs-ci-bot output below.
docs-ci-bot: preview check failed
```
ERROR: docs-lint: terminology.yml: 'model serving' found in docs/migration.md: line 42
Suggestion: replace with 'inference' or 'inference serving'
ERROR: broken-links: 1
  - https://old.example.com/sdk/python -> 404
INFO: preview: failed (html build ok but checks failed)
```
Sam W.: I'll update the terminology and swap the broken link to /docs/sdk/python/quickstart.
Maya T.: I'll patch the python snippet to the new import and push a tiny commit. tagging @Kevin L. for the wording pass.
Kevin L.: Nice — also keep inline examples to the point. If we need to show sample output, use a one-line comment example rather than long output blocks.
Anya P.: Merge timing: require docs CI green + 1 eng + 1 docs approver. I'm free at 11:30 PT today. If CI is green earlier, please wait until 11:45 PT so we don't overlap the release window.
Sam W.: Sounds good. I'll do final signoff after CI green and once Kevin's comments are addressed. :thumbsup:
docs-ci-bot: preview succeeded https://deploy.preview/redwood/pr-3426/preview  (after fixes)
Kevin L.: Doing a final pass now, left two tiny wording suggestions inline.
Sam W.: Thanks everyone — merging once approvals are on the PR. If you want a quick follow-up review, ping me in this thread.
